steps.name: Einst's Letter
steps.objective: Go to the "Guild Union" and talk to Einst.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Oh, you're here. Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you call me here for?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Goodness... Straight to business without even time for a greeting?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: You seem a little more impatient than before. You weren't quite like this when we first met.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Then I'll get right to it.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Flari, a fairy who tends Aurora Forest, has asked me for help. I came to know the fairies through a turn of events, and we've been friends for a long time.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Flari rarely asks for help, even in difficult times. For her to reach out personally, something serious must be happening. I suspect it concerns Queen Aurora, the ruler of the forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is Queen Aurora?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Put simply, she's a queen of flowers who loves beautiful things.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Born as a spirit, she oversees the fairies and tends the forest. I've heard she sometimes takes her pursuit of beauty a little too far.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, that reminds me of Zoe...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. I'll take care of it.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: You certainly sound confident.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Be careful when dealing with Queen Aurora.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: She has a rather unusual personality, but she was never particularly wicked.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Go to Aurora Forest and hear the details there.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: The fairy Flari is at the entrance. Find her, and she'll tell you exactly what's happening with Queen Aurora.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Ah, you can reach Aurora Forest through Coral Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Before I go, is there anything else I should watch out for?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Hmm... You can ask Flari about that as well. Good luck, then. Have a safe trip.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm. Is this serious enough that I'll need luck?)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Still, that adventurer seems rather unsettled. I wonder if everything is all right.

steps.name: To Aurora Forest!
steps.objective: Go to the "Aurora Forest" and talk to Flari.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Excuse me, are you the one Einst sent? The... adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's me. You're Flari the fairy, right? I heard you asked Einst for help.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Oh, thank you. I've been waiting for you. I'm so grateful that you came all this way at the request of someone you've never even met.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The road through the forest was a little rough, but now that I'm here, I feel better.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somehow, I feel more relaxed...

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Isn't it lovely? Aurora Forest really is the most peaceful place in the world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...No, it's a little different from that...

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Hmm? I'm not sure what you mean.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Flari looks at me in confusion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's nothing. So what can I help you with? Einst told me to come here and hear the details.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Oh, w-well, you see...

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: All right, I'll explain. Aurora Forest was created through the power of Aurora, Queen of Flowers.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: The forest's inhabitants decided to name it Aurora Forest, hoping it would last forever. To be honest, the other suggestions were dreadful...

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Queen Aurora naturally loves beautiful things and despises anything untidy.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: She's also rather haughty. She tends to dismiss anything she dislikes as foolish, or simply ignore it.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: As long as we didn't cross her path, that wasn't a problem. We hardly ever saw the Queen, anyway.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: But something must have happened to her, because she started singing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there something wrong with her singing?

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: She's terribly bad at it. Lots of people sing badly, but that's not the real problem. Her voice carries frighteningly well.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Morning, evening, before dawn... Whenever she's awake, she sings. Her voice carries beyond the garden and fills the entire forest. It practically shakes the trees.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: She doesn't seem to realize it, since she keeps on singing... Sigh. Everyone is so stressed by it that they can barely function.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Some of the residents have even started behaving strangely...

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Even the good-natured unicorns are suffering nervous breakdowns.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: The gods really are cruel. Why give Queen Aurora such a powerful voice and nothing else? They could have given her a pleasant tone too...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Flari seems very upset.)

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: For the sake of peace in the forest, we have to stop Queen Aurora's singing. Please help us!

steps.name: Bad Behavior Has Consequences
steps.objective: Defeat the [Aurora Queen], then report to Flari.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Please listen to me, Lady Aurora.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Why did you suddenly start singing when you never showed any interest in it before?

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: (Aurora hesitates before speaking. She seems a little embarrassed to bring it up.)

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: It's because of a human man.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: What? What? Lady Aurora, you're interested in someone else?

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Oh my goodness... You, who never cared about anyone but yourself and treated everyone else as servants, are interested in a man? A human man, at that?

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: You never even spare humans a thought. How did this happen...?

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: S-stop it. Be quiet!! I didn't expect it either!

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: But he was so handsome, strong, and kind. I couldn't help it!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What sort of person could move your heart so much, Your Majesty?

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Exactly. Who on earth is this man...?

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: H-his name is Levi Arens. You there, human adventurer. Do you know Levi Arens?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Him?

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: Oh, you know him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I know him. He works for the royal court of Elias.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: The Kingdom of Elias?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a kingdom on the Jiendia continent.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: The Jiendia continent, captain of the Elias royal guard... That's useful information.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: Thank you. I'd like to visit if I ever get the chance. Thank you, human adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how does Levi know you, Your Majesty? Did he have a reason to come all the way here?

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: I don't know why he was here... A while ago, I briefly left the forest on business and found myself in danger.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: He saved me then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. He would never walk past someone in trouble.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: After that, I couldn't stop thinking about him. Strange, isn't it? Me, thinking about a human man.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: Then I remembered a melody he had been humming and started singing it myself.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: I thought that if I learned to sing it well, I might be able to sing it for Levi Arens someday.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: I'm sorry. I thought I was only practicing. I had no idea I was shaking the whole forest...

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: It's all right, Lady Aurora. If you started practicing because you fell for that human man and wanted to impress him, well...

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: In that case, perhaps I can help?

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: How exactly do you intend to help?

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: I have a friend who's a wonderful singer. Her teaching methods have helped lots of people learn to sing well.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: With lessons from my friend, I'm sure you could do well too, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: With your power, I believe you can sing without harming the garden or the forest.

lines.speaker: 오로라
lines.text: Ahem. Well, if you insist, I'll try to hold back.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Wonderful. Then it's settled? Please refrain from singing just until then.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: I'll arrange things with my friend as quickly as possible and let you know.

lines.speaker: 플라리
lines.text: Phew. Thank you so much, adventurer! Everything worked out thanks to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad it ended well. Flari, please quietly mention something to Lady Aurora later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Levi likes considerate people more than people who can sing well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Flari smiles and nods in understanding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Shall I head back now? Though for some reason, I have a feeling I'll be seeing Queen Aurora quite often...)
